motions.description: Motion to excuse Trustee Kaminski from the evening's meeting.
Approval of all items on the consent agenda including meeting minutes, bills and vouchers for September 2025, various license applications, and multiple ordinances and resolutions.

Approval of a raffle application submitted by Len Buonincontro, Project 22Nine President, to hold a 'Queen of Hearts' raffle at Caputo's Fresh Market in Elmwood Park from November 1, 2025 to January 31, 2026.
